toolbar.gitStatusOn: Git status on — click to turn off
toolbar.gitStatusOff: Git status off — click to turn on

settings.title: Settings
settings.textSectionHint: Choose the terminal font, size, and text color.
settings.scrollbackHint: Number of lines kept for scrolling (100–100000).
settings.startDirectoryHint: Folder used when a new tab starts. Leave empty to use the home folder. Missing folders fall back to home. Supports ~.
settings.statusBarHint: Display session info at the bottom of the window.
settings.trayIconHint: Puts a MyTerminal icon in the system tray: clicking it opens Settings, and its menu shows the window or quits. Closing the last window quits the program. (desktop app only)
settings.backgroundHint: Solid terminal background color (shown behind the wallpaper).
settings.backgroundImageHint: Add wallpapers to the library, then click one to use it.
settings.bgImageTransparencyHint: Wallpaper image transparency: 0% = fully visible, 100% = hidden. (The toolbar slider controls the whole window's opacity.)
settings.backgroundFitHint: How the background image is placed in the terminal area.
settings.backgroundImageShowHint: Turn the wallpaper on or off without removing it from the library.
settings.lsColorsHint: Colors used for directory and regular file names in ls / dir. Change these if a background image makes them hard to read.
settings.shellCustomPathPlaceholder: Full path to the shell program
settings.shellHint: The program that runs each command line you type (cd, ls, cat… stay built in). Every line runs in a fresh instance of that shell; the working directory and environment are kept by MyTerminal.
settings.themeColorsHint: Changes are stored for the current theme (marked ✎ on the Theme tab). Reset restores only this theme’s colours.
settings.themePickHint: Click a theme to apply it. Individual colours can be changed on the Colours tab and are stored per theme (✎). Reset restores only the current theme’s colours; other themes, prompts and wallpapers are kept.
settings.sshSub: saved connections — pick one in the SSH dialog
settings.sshEmpty: No saved hosts yet — click Add.
settings.sshHint: Passwords and key passphrases are never saved; enter them when connecting. Deleting a host only removes it from this list.
settings.profilesSub: size · font · scrollback · shell, saved under a name
settings.profileSaveCurrentTip: A new profile with this window’s terminal size, font, scrollback and shell
settings.profileEmpty: No profiles yet — Add, or From current.
settings.profileApplyHint: Sets the font, size, scrollback and default shell, then resizes the window so the terminal shows exactly these columns × rows.
settings.defaultTermSizeHint: Columns × rows the window is fitted to on first launch (default 120 × 25); changing it resizes this window. The toolbar sets the minimum width, so the terminal may end up wider.

about.title: About MyTerminal
about.description: A modern cross-platform terminal for Windows, Linux, macOS, and Web. Features theming, bilingual UI, and a frameless toolbar experience.
about.author: Author

terminal.welcome: MyTerminal Shell — built-in shell by SHKWON
terminal.webNotice: Web mode: built-in shell with virtual filesystem. Type help for commands.

prompt.title: Shell prompt
prompt.hint: Click a preset to apply it. Pick the segments, shape and path style here; each segment’s colours and template are on the “Prompt edit” tab.
prompt.preview: clean repository / changed repository / no repository
prompt.updateCustomTip: Save this custom prompt as it looks now
prompt.customHint: Saved prompts can be picked from the list again, renamed or deleted.
prompt.gitColorsTip: Only the branch (git) block takes the repository state colour: green clean → red modified → yellow staged → orange committed → green pushed; crimson conflicts, blue behind. Every other segment keeps the theme colours; off: theme colours for the branch too.
prompt.advancedHint: Pick a segment on the left; edit its colours and template on the right.
prompt.selectHint: Pick a segment in the list on the left.

prompt.bgTemplatesHint: one per line, first match wins

tabs.dragHint: Drag outside for a new window, or onto another MyTerminal window to merge as a tab
tabs.detachPreviewHint: Release to open in a new window
tabs.mergePreviewHint: Release to merge as a tab

ssh.hint: Use password or a private key file. Remote shell replaces the local session until you disconnect.
ssh.webOnly: SSH remote terminal is available in the desktop app.
